question: Which of the following is found in plant cells only?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cell wall.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plant cells** have a rigid cell wall made up of **cellulose, **which provides **structural support and protection **to the cell.
 
• The cell membrane is present in both **plant and animal cells,** and it forms a barrier between the cell and its environment, controlling the movement of substances in and out of the cell.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cell membrane:**

 
 
• It is a** thin, flexible barrier** made up of **lipids and proteins** that surrounds the cell and regulates the movement of materials in and out of the cell.
 
 
 
• **Nucleolus:**
 
 
• It is a **dense, spherical structure** found within the nucleus of eukaryotic cells, which is involved in the synthesis of **ribosomal RNA** and the assembly of ribosomes.
 
 
 
• **Mitochondria:**
 
 
• These are **membrane-bound organelles** found in **eukaryotic cells**, which are responsible for producing energy in the form of **ATP through cellular respiration**.
 
• They contain their** own DNA** and can replicate independently within the cell.
